📋 Synced with ENCOR v1.2 (March 19, 2026) — Wireless section (3.3) REMOVED · OSPFv3 now explicit in 3.2b · Catalyst Center replaces DNA Center · Zero Trust & SASE added to Security
1.0 Architecture — 15% of exam
✓1.1b High availability — SSO, NSF, StackWise redundancy (sso + stacking)
1.1a Enterprise design — 2-tier, 3-tier, spine-leaf, fabric, cloud
✓1.1b FHRP — HSRP, VRRP, GLBP (covered under 3.3c — fhrp, vrrp, vrrp_adv)
1.2 SD-WAN — vManage, vSmart, vBond, control/data plane, benefits & limits
1.3 SD-Access — control/data plane elements, campus interoperability
✓1.4 QoS — DSCP, CoS, classification, marking, CBWFQ, LLQ, policing, shaping, WRED (qos)
2.0 Virtualization — 10% of exam
✓2.2a VRF / VRF-lite — traffic isolation, overlapping IPs, route leaking (vrf_lite)
✓2.2b GRE tunnels, MTU, PMTUD, fragmentation (mtu)
2.1a Hypervisor type 1 and type 2 — bare metal vs hosted
2.1b Virtual machines — vCPU, vRAM, snapshots
2.1c Virtual switching — vSwitch, DVS, port groups
2.2b IPsec — IKEv1/v2, transform sets, crypto maps, tunnel vs transport
2.3a LISP — locator/ID separation, EID, RLOC, map server/resolver
2.3b VXLAN — VNI, VTEP, underlay/overlay, L2 extension over L3
3.0 Infrastructure — 30% of exam
Layer 2 (3.1)
✓3.1a VLANs, 802.1q trunking, DTP, VTP (vlans + dtp + vtp)
✓3.1b EtherChannel — static, LACP, PAgP, load balancing (3 lessons)
✓3.1c STP full suite — RSTP, MST, root guard, BPDU guard (12 lessons)
Layer 3 (3.2)
✓3.2a EIGRP vs OSPF — advanced DV vs link-state, DUAL, FD/RD, FC (eigrp)
✓3.2a EIGRP Named Mode, variance, stub, Wide Metrics (eigrp_adv)
✓3.2b OSPF basics — areas, router roles, cost, DR/BDR, 7 states (ospf_basics)
✓3.2b OSPF packets — Hello/DBD/LSR/LSU/LSAck (ospf_packets)
✓3.2b OSPF adjacencies — network types, mismatches, troubleshooting (ospf_adj)
✓3.2b OSPF LSA types 1-7, flooding scope, E1/E2 (ospf_lsa)
✓3.2b OSPF area types — Stub, Totally Stub, NSSA, Totally NSSA (ospf_areas)
✓3.2b OSPF summarization, area range, distribute-list, filtering (ospf_summary)
✓3.2b OSPFv3 — IPv6, link-local, T8/T9 LSAs, address-family mode (ospf_v3)
✓3.2c eBGP — neighbor relationships, best path selection, attributes (bgp + bgp_attrs)
✓3.2d PBR — policy-based routing, route-map, source steering (pbr)
✓Dynamic routing fundamentals — AD table, IGP/EGP, ECMP (dynamic_routing)
✓Static routing — recursive, floating static, default route (static_routing)
IP Services (3.3)
✓3.3a NTP — stratum, client/server, auth, troubleshooting (ntp)
✓3.3a NTP security — MD5 auth, access-groups, peer, hardware clock (ntp_adv)
✓3.3a PTP — IEEE 1588, GMC, BC, T1-T4, nanosecond accuracy (ptp)
✓3.3b NAT — intro, static, inside/outside source, debug (nat + nat_adv)
✓3.3b NAT dynamic pool, ACL matching, pool exhaustion (nat_dynamic)
✓3.3b PAT overload, port multiplexing, port tracking (nat_pat)
✓3.3b NAT Virtual Interface — NVI vs legacy, symmetric routing, static PAT (nat_nvi)
✓3.3c FHRP — HSRP active/standby, priority, preempt, timers, auth, tracking (fhrp)
✓3.3c FHRP — VRRP Master/Backup, GLBP AVG/AVF load balancing (vrrp)
✓3.3c VRRP multi-group LB, GLBP weighting/hysteresis, lower/upper thresholds (vrrp_adv)
3.3d Multicast — RPF check, PIM SM, IGMP v2/v3, SSM, bidir, MSDP
4.0 Network Assurance — 10% of exam
✓4.1 ICMP types/codes, ping, TTL, NDP (icmp)
✓4.1 Traceroute — UDP probe mechanics, TTL exceeded (traceroute)
✓4.1 IOS debug and conditional debug commands (debug)
✓4.1 MSS, TCP diagnostics (mss)
4.1 SNMP — v2c vs v3, OID, MIB, polling, traps, inform
4.1 Syslog — severity levels 0-7, remote logging, facility codes
4.2 Flexible NetFlow — flow records, exporters, monitors, verify
4.3 SPAN / RSPAN / ERSPAN — local and remote traffic capture
4.4 IP SLA — probes, jitter, reactions, thresholds, object tracking
4.5 Cisco Catalyst Center — network config, monitoring, AI workflows
4.6 NETCONF and RESTCONF — operational data, config management
5.0 Security — 20% of exam
5.1a Device access control — console/VTY lines, local auth, SSH, privilege levels
5.1b AAA — RADIUS, TACACS+, authentication, authorization, accounting
5.2a ACLs — standard, extended, named, reflexive, IPv6, time-based
5.2b CoPP — Control Plane Policing, class-map, policy-map, service-policy
5.3 REST API security — tokens, HTTPS, OAuth 2.0, rate limiting
5.4a Threat defense — IPS/IDS, firewall zones, inspection
5.4b Endpoint security — AMP, posture assessment, malware protection
5.4c Next-generation firewall — FTD, FMC, application visibility
5.4d TrustSec and MACsec — SGT, SXP, 802.1AE encryption
6.0 Automation & AI — 15% of exam
✓CEF / dCEF / process switching — forwarding architecture (cef + dcef)
✓L2/L3 forwarding, MAC table, FIB/RIB, SDM (l2 + l3 + sdm)
6.1 Python — variables, loops, functions, Netmiko, NAPALM basics
6.2 JSON — encoding, parsing, nested structures, Python json module
6.3 YANG — data modeling, modules, leafs, containers, deviations
6.4 Catalyst Center APIs and SD-WAN Manager (vManage) APIs
6.5 REST API response codes, RESTCONF payloads, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE
6.6 EEM applets — event triggers, action commands, automation
6.7 Agent vs agentless tools — Ansible, Puppet, Chef, SaltStack
